title: Prove the clean square-zero coupling optimum with priced primitive lowering
body:
For a rank-q square-zero binary coupling, allowing returned clean workspace changes the exact reflection-call minimum to q+1. At rank two, one clean role permits three calls where Nick Petalas's PR #4912 proves four with dirty workspace. The uniform lower bound allows arbitrary finite clean and restored dirty helpers, with free constant binary scalar mixing. The even-rank construction and its clean return are explicit.

The package also lowers every call to literal coordinate reflections and scalar CNOTs, including inverse operations and common basis transport. Its canonical even-rank word costs `(q+1)R + 2q(q+2)C + H`; the explicitly lowered predecessor split compiler costs `(q+2)R + (2q²-4)C`. It wins exactly when `R > 4(q+1)C + H`. In particular the first fixture is `3R+16C+H` versus `4R+4C`. These are prices of specified words; scalar-network optimality and a native clean-resource price are unclaimed.

[Canonical CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1317#discussioncomment-19139341). Three substantive commits separate the proof/compiler, independent primitive interpreter, and actual corruption/relocation controls. Only the new opt-in `research/clean-square-zero-compiler/` package changes.

Evidence at head `7c9247ea3878906715c136421d5e5248535596fe`:

- The written proof normalizes free scalar maps on active input columns, uses rank saturation to exclude q calls, and constructs q+1 legal projectors. Even-rank helpers have full action `[g]`, so only their initialized zero state returns; a dirty replacement is explicitly rejected.
- Primary checks cover all 343 square-zero binary matrices through four data roles, eight nontrivially conjugated rank-one through rank-eight fixtures with dirty spectators, exact clean-column one/two-call obstructions, and literal scalar counts through even rank sixteen.
- The independent faithful-action interpreter executes one scalar CNOT or one address swap at a time. It checks 351 fixtures, all 3,556 full input basis columns, 160 dense dirty states, separately computed clean-column shortest sums, 44 omitted reflections, four dirty-ancilla failures and four noninvolutory-label failures.
- Six actual relocated CLI tests check normal/optimized read-only replay, source corruption, Boolean receipt corruption, an incorrect reflection role, an omitted clean projector and a missing scalar inverse. The wrong-reflection-role mutant passes the algebra/count checker and fails the independently implemented literal endpoint oracle.
- All five registered commands pass under CPython 3.12.2 on macOS arm64, standard library only. The two scientific scripts also pass directly under CPython 3.14.6; the generic launcher correctly requires Python 3.12.
- Metadata, final committed bytes/source-history, official 11-file export and export integrity pass. All five commands pass from the checked export with Git absent from PATH; all exported bytes remain unchanged. Cold times are 0.254/0.264 seconds for the primary normal/optimized checks, 0.180/0.179 seconds for the literal checks, and 1.890 seconds for the actual CLI controls.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/clean-square-zero-compiler
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/clean-square-zero-compiler --check-source-history
```

Scope and remaining obligations: the full formal group algebra is F2[C2] for one fixed nonidentity involution, and paid couplings remain binary rank-one idempotents. The theorem is a written uniform argument; finite checks corroborate it. A clean address function, its reservation charge H, complete stationary primitive prices, physical tapes/routing/frames and native reflection implementation are not supplied. No scalar-network optimum, recursive supplier admission, new κ, selected-frontier change or full multiplication theorem is claimed. Lean, Docker, the full selected cold replay and predecessor executables were not run. Open next questions identify a literal native price binding and a matched optimization of both primitive streams.

Source/overlap: canonical main `bee95ce88f9f19802f0613f92838895cd0e14a1f`, priority revision 7. Main retains PR #4912 head `eaea286b055724895adb4ca949b5ac0495be5ff8`; its live body, head and comments were read. The initial complete cache covers 310 open PRs at 2026-10-23 06:05:59 UTC, 4096 Discussion records at 06:06:48 UTC, and all 6690 main package notes. The square-zero/clean query has twelve related leads and no same minimum. Cached text, omitted arbitrary diffs/history and unpublished work remain coverage limits. Submission refresh is recorded separately before publication.
